gaps.explanation: last did X in (year) = haven't done X since (year).

gaps.lead: A mechanic repaired my father's roof last week.
gaps.explanation: have something done = arrange for somebody to do it: had his roof repaired.

gaps.lead: They have accused the mayor of corruption.
gaps.explanation: Active 'they have accused him of' becomes passive: has been accused of.
costs less = is less expensive; 'considerably' keeps the degree.

gaps.lead: It isn't necessary to book in advance.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't have to' = it is not necessary.

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings in this room,' the guide warned us.
gaps.sentence: The guide warned ___ the paintings in that room.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with warned + object + not to + infinitive.
